# Charging an RC circuit
A capacitor charged through a resistor. The time constant $\tau = RC$ comes out in seconds automatically.
The differential equation $RC \, v' + v = V_s$ solved exactly with $v(0) = 0$ (from the `ode` module):
v_sym = dsolve(d(v, t) == -v/tau + V_s/tau, v, t, 0, 0)
